items.title: AI代理當臥底 引誘詐騙分子上鉤 新創公司獲近1,000萬美元融資
items.title_en: AI Agents Go Undercover to Lure Scammers; Startup Secures Nearly $10 Million Funding
paras: 據《TechCrunch》報導，澳洲新創公司Apate正在使用AI代理應對電信詐騙，通過浪費騙子時間、獲取詐騙訊息等方式，阻止潛在詐騙。
這家澳洲公司成立於2024年，源於麥覺理大學（Macquarie University）的一項研究。Apate部署了數千個偽裝成無辜受害者的AI代理。
這些AI代理可以接聽詐騙電話、回覆可疑簡訊和電子郵件、點擊釣魚連結、加入社交媒體群組，引誘詐騙分子上鉤。
AI代理會偽裝成形形色色的人，有著不同的年齡、性別和口音，並能說多種語言，試圖盡可能拖住騙子，從而套取出有用訊息。
Apate表示，目前其AI代理大軍已在250萬次對話中累計浪費了騙子17年時間。
對Apate用戶而言，更重要的是，這些臥底AI代理會設法誘使騙子吐露一些通常只有在受害者被騙後才能掌握的訊息：銀行賬戶、加密貨幣錢包、電話號碼、惡意網站、他們所冒充的品牌。
作為今年TechCrunch Disrupt大會「創業競技場200強」（Startup Battlefield 200）的決賽入圍者之一，Apate會將這些訊息提供給客戶，供其制定和完善反詐措施與行動方案。
這是「反詐騙」的一種奇妙演變，但考慮到AI在很大程度上助長了詐騙分子和駭客氣焰，這也不令人意外。美國聯邦調查局（FBI）2025年接到超過2.2萬起與AI相關的犯罪投訴，造成的損失約8.93億美元，其中超過6.32億美元屬於投資詐騙。
FBI表示，在這類騙局中，欺詐者會利用AI進行對話，偽造名人、企業高層和受信任人士的聲音與外貌。
今年8月，Apate獲得由Lobby Capital、OIF Ventures、Investible、Concept Ventures和Baobab Ventures投資的815萬美元種子輪融資。
這家由20名員工組成的公司，累計融資額接近1,000萬美元。Apate計劃將最新一輪資金用於產品研發和國際擴張，包括在倫敦設立辦事處，以及擴大在美國的業務布局。
paras_en: According to TechCrunch, Australian startup Apate is using AI agents to combat telecom fraud by wasting scammers' time, gathering scam messages, and preventing potential fraud.
The Australian company, founded in 2024, originated from a research project at Macquarie University. Apate has deployed thousands of AI agents masquerading as innocent victims.
These AI agents can answer scam calls, reply to suspicious texts and emails, click phishing links, and join social‑media groups, luring scammers into the trap.

The AI agents disguise themselves as a variety of people with different ages, genders, accents, and can speak multiple languages, trying to keep scammers occupied as long as possible to extract useful information.
Apate says its army of AI agents has so far wasted scammers' time by a cumulative 17 years across 2.5 million conversations.

For Apate’s customers, the undercover AI agents also manage to coax scammers into revealing information that victims typically only know after being defrauded: bank accounts, cryptocurrency wallets, phone numbers, malicious websites, and the brands they impersonate.
As a finalist in this year’s TechCrunch Disrupt Startup Battlefield 200, Apate will provide these data to clients to help them devise and refine anti‑fraud measures and response plans.

It is a curious evolution of anti‑fraud tactics, but not surprising given that AI has largely empowered scammers and hackers. The FBI received more than 22,000 AI‑related crime complaints in 2025, resulting in losses of about $893 million, over $632 million of which stemmed from investment fraud.
The FBI says that in such schemes fraudsters use AI to conduct conversations and to fabricate the voices and appearances of celebrities, corporate executives, and trusted individuals.
In August this year, Apate secured a $8.15 million seed round from Lobby Capital, OIF Ventures, Investible, Concept Ventures and Baobab Ventures.

The 20‑person company has raised close to $10 million in total. Apate plans to use the latest funding for product development and international expansion, including opening an office in London and scaling its U.S. operations.

items.title: 星巴克「消費才能入座」？中國有門市已收到通知！
items.title_en: Starbucks “Only Paying Customers May Sit”? Some Chinese Stores Have Already Been Notified!
paras: 中國網上19日（周一）晚間傳出星巴克(SBUX-US) 20日起將實施「消費方可入座」的規定，星巴克中國顧客關懷中心對此表示，歡迎所有顧客到門市體驗，若有消費的顧客找不到座位，門市夥伴會去和未消費顧客溝通。
這場爭議源於一組星巴克門市物料照片。照片顯示，一張題為《星巴克「第三空間」倡議》的海報提出，希望顧客合理使用座位與公共區域，控制交談音量，共同維護友好公共環境。
配套桌牌上的提示則更加直接：「星巴克營業空間，請消費入座。」
「已經收到消費入座的口頭通知。」星巴克廣州寺右新馬路店店員20日稱，消費入座不是強制，只是一個提倡，「不消費坐一下是可以的，但是如果有別的顧客就是點了餐，他們沒有位置的話，可能就需要去調整一下，肯定要優先給消費的顧客入座。」
廣州其他星巴克門市則表示，沒收到上級有關消費入座的提示。
據《南方日報》報導，顧客對此有不同看法。有顧客認為，星巴克長期以來將開放的「第三空間」（指家庭和工作之外能放鬆社交的公共場所）作為品牌特色，如果開始限制未消費顧客入座，可能與經營理念產生衝突。
也有不少顧客認為，相對低的「門檻」，也容易催生一些亂象。比如，有人不消費長時間佔用座位，還有人桌面堆滿私人物品、隨手留下垃圾。門市的座位、保潔、水電，都是實實在在的經營成本。當這些資源被無償佔用，真正花錢消費的顧客反倒無座可坐。品牌適時調整規則，優先保障付費消費者的體驗，的確無可厚非。
不少星巴克門市強調，規則並非一刀切，外賣騎手、躲雨路人、孕婦、值班安保，有短暫休息需要，依舊可以免費進店歇腳。
paras_en: On the evening of Monday, October 19, reports surfaced online in China that Starbucks (SBUX-US) will implement a “pay‑to‑sit” rule starting October 20. Starbucks China’s customer care center said it welcomes all customers to visit its stores, and if a paying customer cannot find a seat, staff will speak with non‑paying customers to resolve the issue.

The controversy stems from a set of store‑level materials. The photos show a poster titled “Starbucks ‘Third Place’ Initiative” that asks customers to use seats and public areas responsibly, keep conversation volume moderate, and help maintain a friendly public environment.
The accompanying tabletop sign is more direct: “Starbucks retail space – please sit only after purchasing.”

“We’ve already received a verbal notice about the pay‑to‑sit policy,” said an employee at the Guangzhou Siyi Xinma Road store on the 20th. He clarified that the rule is not mandatory but a recommendation: “You can sit without ordering, but if another customer has placed an order and there’s no seat available, we may need to adjust, and paying customers will be given priority.”
Other Starbucks locations in Guangzhou said they have not received any guidance from higher‑ups regarding the pay‑to‑sit policy.

According to the Southern Daily, customers have mixed reactions. Some argue that Starbucks has long marketed its open “third place” – a public space for relaxation and socializing outside home and work – as a core brand feature, and restricting non‑paying patrons could clash with that philosophy.

Others point out that a low barrier to sitting can create problems. Some people occupy seats for long periods without buying, pile personal items on tables, or leave trash behind. Seating, cleaning, water and electricity are real operating costs. When these resources are used for free, paying customers may find no seats. Adjusting the rule to protect paying customers’ experience is therefore understandable.

Many Starbucks stores emphasize that the rule is not applied uniformly. Takeout riders, people seeking shelter from rain, pregnant women, and on‑duty security staff who need a brief rest are still allowed to enter and sit for free.

items.title: 〈財報〉法國暴亂衝擊！家樂福下修全年財測 營業利益估最多受損2億歐元
items.title_en: <Earnings> French Riots Impact! Carrefour Cuts Full-Year Outlook, Operating Profit Could Lose Up to €200 Million
paras: 法國零售巨頭家樂福 (Carrefour) 週二 (20 日) 公布第三季銷售業績，同店銷售額年增 2.3%，但法國近期暴動、搶掠與宵禁措施衝擊門市營運，迫使公司下修全年獲利與現金流展望，並削減資本支出。
家樂福第三季含稅銷售額為 226.94 億歐元，按當期匯率計算年增 3.9%，此數字尚未計入阿根廷高度通膨會計調整。排除汽油、日曆與匯率等因素後，同店銷售額成長 2.3%，略高於上半年的 2.1%。其中，食品銷售成長 2.7%，非食品銷售則下滑 1.1%。
法國、西班牙與巴西三大核心市場均維持成長。
法國同店銷售額增加 1.2%，西班牙與巴西分別成長 2.1% 和 1.4%。集團電商業務同期成長 18%，成為另一項營運亮點。
不過，進入零售業關鍵的第四季後，法國社會動盪使營運前景轉趨保守。
家樂福執行長 Alexandre Bompard 表示，公司正面臨法國「前所未見的情況」，動亂首日就有約 50 家門市受到波及，其中多家遭到搶掠，損害嚴重。
財務長 Matthieu Malige 估計，相關事件對營業利益的衝擊可能介於 8,000 萬至 2 億歐元。除了商品失竊與設施受損，門市停業也造成損失。
家樂福因此將 2026 年調整後每股盈餘展望，由原先的高個位數百分比成長，下修為持平至小幅成長；經常性營業利益率的年增幅目標，也從原先的 25 個基點，降至 0 至 15 個基點，相當於持平至增加 0.15 個百分點，但仍預期經常性營業利益將成長。
此外，全年淨自由現金流預期由小幅成長轉為小幅下滑。
公司將減少今年剩餘期間在法國的投資，並將集團全年資本支出目標，由 17 億歐元降至 16 億歐元。
家樂福指出，能源價格上漲已壓抑消費者購買力，近期動亂進一步打擊消費信心。門市來客數減少、宵禁導致營業時間縮短，加上保全與物流成本攀升，都為年終購物旺季增添變數。
儘管下修財測，公司仍維持既定策略方向，以及全年節省 10 億歐元成本的目標。
家樂福 (CA-FR) 週二 (20 日) 股價小漲0.31%，報每股 16.30 歐元，略低於開盤價 16.32 歐元，盤中最高觸及 16.48 歐元，最低下探 16.24 歐元。
瑞銀分析師 Sreedhar Mahamkali 認為，家樂福此次對利潤率與自由現金流的下修幅度相當大。
花旗分析師 Monique Pollard 則推算，新財測可能意味著法國第 4 季營業利益下滑逾 50%，形容這是「相當極端的情境」。
paras_en: Carrefour, the French retail giant, released its third‑quarter sales results on Tuesday (the 20th), showing a 2.3% same‑store sales increase year‑on‑year, but recent riots, looting and curfew measures in France have disrupted store operations, forcing the company to lower its full‑year profit and cash‑flow outlook and to cut capital spending.

Carrefour’s third‑quarter sales, including tax, amounted to €22.694 billion, up 3.9% year‑on‑year at the current exchange rate, a figure that does not yet reflect accounting adjustments for Argentina’s high inflation. Excluding fuel, calendar effects and exchange‑rate impacts, same‑store sales grew 2.3%, slightly above the 2.1% growth in the first half. Food sales rose 2.7% while non‑food sales fell 1.1%.
France, Spain and Brazil – the three core markets – all continued to grow.

Same‑store sales in France rose 1.2%, while Spain and Brazil posted 2.1% and 1.4% growth respectively. The group’s e‑commerce business expanded 18% over the same period, becoming another operational highlight.
However, as the crucial fourth quarter for retail approaches, social unrest in France is making the operating outlook more cautious.

CEO Alexandre Bompard said the company is facing an "unprecedented situation" in France, with about 50 stores affected on the first day of the unrest, many of which were looted and suffered serious damage.

Chief Financial Officer Matthieu Malige estimated that the incidents could hit operating profit by €80 million to €200 million. In addition to theft of merchandise and damage to facilities, store closures also caused losses.

Carrefour therefore revised its 2026 adjusted earnings‑per‑share outlook from a high‑single‑digit percent increase to a flat‑to‑slight‑growth range; the target annual increase in recurring operating margin was also lowered from 25 basis points to a range of 0‑15 basis points, equivalent to flat to a 0.15‑percentage‑point rise, though recurring operating profit is still expected to grow.
Furthermore, the full‑year net free cash‑flow outlook was changed from modest growth to a slight decline.
The company will reduce its remaining‑year investments in France and cut its group‑wide capital‑expenditure target from €1.7 billion to €1.6 billion.

Carrefour noted that higher energy prices have already squeezed consumer purchasing power and that the recent unrest further dented consumer confidence. Fewer store visitors, curfews shortening opening hours, and rising security and logistics costs all add uncertainty to the year‑end shopping season.
Despite the lowered outlook, the company maintains its strategic direction and its goal to save €1 billion in costs over the year.
Carrefour (CA‑FR) shares edged up 0.31% on Tuesday (the 20th), trading at €16.30 per share, slightly below the opening price of €16.32, with an intraday high of €16.48 and a low of €16.24.
UBS analyst Sreedhar Mahamkali said Carrefour’s downward revisions to profit margins and free cash flow are quite large.
Citi analyst Monique Pollard calculated that the new outlook could imply a drop of more than 50% in operating profit for France in Q4, describing it as an "extremely extreme scenario".

items.title: 美光震盪收黑 AI投資疑慮升溫、韓國新股慘跌與桃園罷工添壓力
items.title_en: Micron Slides as AI Investment Concerns Rise, Korean IPO Crashes, and Taoyuan Strike Adds Pressure
paras: 美光(Micron)(MU-US)周二(20日)股價一度走高，但終場仍無法收在平盤之上，三大警訊正壟罩在記憶體族群的頭頂。
美光周二終場下跌0.98%，前一交易日上漲3%。
近期晶片股承受沉重賣壓。先前受人工智慧(AI)熱潮推升、估值已大幅拉高的晶片股，如今受到另一項疑慮衝擊：為了擴建AI基礎設施，企業所需承擔的債務不斷增加。
記憶體股周二也走低，SanDisk(SNDK-US)周二下跌0.4%，SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)股價走勢則更顯疲態，在那斯達克交易的股票下跌1.5%。SK海力士在南韓掛牌的股票周二稍早收盤下跌4.2%，創4月中旬以來最低水準。
南韓市場的最新消息，進一步加深投資人對AI產業的疑慮：雲端基礎設施業者Elice備受期待的首次公開發行(IPO)在首爾市場表現失利，掛牌首日股價重挫超過30%。
美光本周也可能面臨罷工風險，代表美光台灣桃園員工的工會表示，因員工獎金爭議，將於本周四發動罷工。桃園是美光最重要的製造據點之一。
巴隆周刊(Barron's)表示，美光9月也曾面臨罷工疑慮，但當時股價成功消化相關利空，這次或許也能再次挺過考驗。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) saw its stock rise briefly on Tuesday (the 20th) but closed below the opening price, with three major warning signs looming over the memory‑chip sector.
Micron ended Tuesday down 0.98% after having risen 3% the previous trading day.

Chip stocks have recently been under heavy selling pressure. After being propelled higher by the AI boom and seeing valuations surge, they are now hit by another worry: companies need to take on increasing debt to expand AI infrastructure.

Memory stocks also fell on Tuesday, with SanDisk (SNDK-US) down 0.4% and SK Hynix (SKHY-US) showing even weaker performance, slipping 1.5% on the Nasdaq. SK Hynix’s shares listed in South Korea fell 4.2% earlier in the day, hitting their lowest level since mid‑April.

The latest news from the South Korean market deepens investors’ doubts about the AI industry: cloud‑infrastructure provider Elice’s highly anticipated IPO performed poorly on the Seoul exchange, with the debut price plunging more than 30% on the first day.

Micron may also face strike risk this week, as the union representing Micron’s Taoyuan, Taiwan employees announced a strike on Thursday over a bonus dispute. Taoyuan is one of Micron’s most important manufacturing sites.
Barron’s noted that Micron faced strike concerns in September, but the stock then absorbed the negative news; it may be able to weather this challenge again.

items.title: 一文掌握SpaceX電話會議重點：明年底AI算力目標約13GW Terafab拚2028年量產晶片
items.title_en: Key Takeaways from SpaceX Earnings Call: Targeting About 13 GW of AI Compute by End‑2027, Terafab Aims for Chip Production in 2028
paras: SpaceX (SPCX-US) 週二 (20 日) 公布第 3 季財報，營收年增 161%，並轉虧為盈。馬斯克等高層在財報電話會議上預估，2027 年第 1 季營收可望達 330 億至 370 億美元，同時曝光 AI 算力目標、星艦挑戰、Terafab 晶片量產時程。
營收年增161% 單季淨利44億美元
SpaceX 第 3 季營收約 146 億美元，淨利達 44 億美元，較去年同期淨虧損 11 億美元大幅改善；調整後稅息折舊及攤銷前獲利 (EBITDA) 約 88 億美元，年增 306%。
第4季資本支出上看400億美元 明年首季營收挑戰370億美元
第 3 季資本支出約 196 億美元，主要投入超級智慧 (SI) 算力建設、星艦基礎設施及衛星生產。公司預估，第 4 季資本支出將進一步攀升至 350 億至 400 億美元。
隨著算力合約能見度提高，公司預估 2027 年第 1 季營收達 330 億至 370 億美元，高於市場原估約 220 億美元。
SI營收躍增830% 部門營業利益轉正
SI 部門第 3 季營收約 76 億美元，年增 830%，主要受惠於新雲端服務合約啟動、併購 AI 程式開發工具 Cursor，以及 Grok 採用增加。
該部門營業利益達 4.31 億美元，已由虧轉盈，但單季資本支出也達約 164 億美元，反映算力擴張仍需要大量資金。
2027年底算力目標約13GW 電力與冷卻成關鍵
SpaceX 第 3 季底名目算力容量為 1.7 GW，預計 10 月底接近 2 GW，年底達 2.5 至 3 GW。
馬斯克表示，有信心在 2027 年新增約 10 GW 算力，使年底總容量達約 13 GW。他另提出爭取明年新增 20 GW 電力及冷卻設施的積極規畫，但這有賴各項條件順利配合，並非確定能達成的結果。
火箭鑄造技術支援供電 馬斯克稱可縮短交期
馬斯克表示，SpaceX 正將火箭引擎累積的鑄造技術，用於發電渦輪機葉片與導引葉片製造，以縮短關鍵零組件交期。
馬斯克認為，這項能力可望讓公司比競爭對手提前 12 至 18 個月取得可用電力。這是馬斯克對公司製造優勢的評估。
算力自用與出租各半 Grok Bot付費週活躍用戶達80萬
馬斯克表示，公司大致以自用及對外出租各半為算力配置方向，並依需求調整。他偏好短期合約與接近現貨市場的定價方式，押注算力需求持續強勁。
應用服務方面，Grok Bot 的付費週活躍用戶在 10 月稍早已達 80 萬，企業市場是成長最快的類別。
Terafab力拚2027年測試晶片運作 2028年量產
馬斯克表示，Terafab 的內部目標，是在 2027 年 5 月或 6 月，讓奧斯汀研發廠的首顆測試晶片正常運作，可能以 SRAM 晶片驗證產線。
位於德州吉本斯克里克的主基地，則力拚 2028 年第 3 季左右進入量產。不過，他強調這些時程相當積極，仍存在很大的不確定性。
星艦11月試飛 將挑戰同時回收助推火箭與船體
星艦第 14 次試飛已成功進入軌道，並部署可運作的 V3 星鏈衛星。預計 11 月進行的第 15 次試飛，將挑戰同時回收助推器與星艦本體，但馬斯克強調成功並無保證。
公司希望在 2027 年上半年某個時間點達到每週發射一次，下半年提高至每週兩次或更多。此外，正在開發的路易斯安那太空港，長期可能設置約 20 座或更多發射塔。
星鏈訂戶達1360萬 航空簽約服務
星鏈第 3 季新增 160 萬名消費級訂戶，季底總數達 1,360 萬，服務涵蓋 174 個市場；Starlink Mobile 月活躍用戶則突破 2,200 萬。
航空市場方面，公司已簽約服務約 1.2 萬架飛機，合作對象包括美國四大航空公司中的三家。這是簽約數量，並不代表全部已完成安裝。
隨著 V3 衛星部署及星艦載荷增加，公司預期單次星艦發射所新增的下行容量，將朝目前單次獵鷹 9 號發射的 20 倍以上邁進。
與特斯拉成立合併評估委員會 尚未談妥交易條件
馬斯克證實，SpaceX 與特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 已應股東要求，各自成立由獨立董事組成的特別委員會，評估潛在合併。他因利益衝突未參與協商。
馬斯克認為，雙方在 AI 軟體、晶片設計、Terafab、機器人及衛星通訊等領域具有合作效益，但雙方尚未就任何交易條件達成協議，不能將合併視為定局。
據馬斯克說明，特斯拉方面需要代表全體股份 50% 的支持，而非僅取得參與投票股份的過半數，構成相當高的門檻。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) announced its Q3 earnings on Tuesday the 20th, reporting revenue up 161% year‑over‑year and a swing to profitability. In the earnings call, Elon Musk and other executives projected Q1 2027 revenue of $33‑$37 billion, and disclosed AI compute targets, Starship challenges, and the timeline for mass‑producing Terafab chips.
Revenue rose 161% year‑over‑year, with quarterly net profit of $4.4 billion.

SpaceX’s Q3 revenue was about $14.6 billion, with net profit of $4.4 billion, a sharp improvement from a $1.1 billion loss a year earlier; adjusted EBITDA was roughly $8.8 billion, up 306% year‑over‑year.
Q4 capital expenditures are expected to reach $40 billion, and the company is targeting $37 billion revenue in the first quarter of next year.

Q3 capital spending was about $19.6 billion, mainly for super‑intelligence (SI) compute infrastructure, Starship facilities and satellite production. SpaceX expects Q4 capex to climb further to $35‑$40 billion.
With higher visibility on compute contracts, the company now forecasts Q1 2027 revenue of $33‑$37 billion, well above the market’s prior estimate of roughly $22 billion.
SI revenue surged 830% and the segment turned to positive operating profit
SI segment revenue in Q3 was about $7.6 billion, up 830% year‑over‑year, driven by new cloud‑service contracts, the acquisition of AI development tool Cursor, and increased use of Grok.
The segment posted operating profit of $431 million, flipping from a loss, but its quarterly capex was also about $16.4 billion, reflecting the capital‑intensive nature of compute expansion.
Compute target of roughly 13 GW by the end of 2027 makes power and cooling critical
SpaceX’s reported compute capacity at the end of Q3 was 1.7 GW, expected to approach 2 GW by the end of October and reach 2.5‑3 GW by year‑end.

Musk said he is confident the company can add about 10 GW of compute in 2027, bringing total capacity to roughly 13 GW by year‑end. He also outlined an aggressive plan to secure an additional 20 GW of power and cooling capacity for next year, though success depends on many conditions and is not guaranteed.
Rocket‑casting expertise supports power‑generation hardware, Musk says it can cut lead times

Musk explained that SpaceX is applying the casting know‑how accumulated from rocket‑engine production to manufacture turbine and guide‑blade components for power generation, shortening the lead time for these critical parts.
He believes this capability could let SpaceX obtain usable power 12‑18 months earlier than competitors, underscoring his view of a manufacturing advantage.
Compute usage split evenly between internal and external; Grok Bot paid weekly active users hit 800,000

Musk said the company’s compute allocation is roughly 50% for internal use and 50% for external leasing, with flexibility to adjust based on demand. He favors short‑term contracts and spot‑market pricing, betting on continued strong demand for compute.
On the services side, Grok Bot’s paid weekly active users reached 800,000 in early October, with the enterprise segment growing the fastest.
Terafab pushes to test chips in 2027 and mass‑produce in 2028
Musk said Terafab’s internal goal is to have its first test chip operating at the Austin R&D facility by May or June 2027, likely using an SRAM chip to validate the production line.
The main base in Gibsons Creek, Texas, is targeting volume production around Q3 2028, though Musk stressed these timelines are aggressive and carry significant uncertainty.
Starship’s November test flight will attempt simultaneous booster and vehicle recovery

Starship’s 14th test flight successfully reached orbit and deployed an operational V3 Starlink satellite. The planned 15th flight in November will try to recover both the booster and the Starship vehicle, though Musk warned success is not guaranteed.

The company aims to achieve one launch per week in the first half of 2027 and increase to two or more per week in the second half. A new launch complex at Louisiana Spaceport could eventually host about 20 or more launch towers.
Starlink subscriber base hits 13.6 million; aviation contracts signed
Starlink added 1.6 million consumer‑grade subscribers in Q3, bringing the quarter‑end total to 13.6 million across 174 markets; Starlink Mobile’s monthly active users surpassed 22 million.

In the aviation market, SpaceX has signed service agreements for roughly 12,000 aircraft, including three of the four major U.S. airlines. These figures represent contracts signed, not completed installations.
With V3 satellite deployment and larger Starship payloads, the company expects each Starship launch to add downlink capacity more than 20 times that of a single Falcon 9 launch.
SpaceX and Tesla have set up a joint merger evaluation committee; deal terms not yet agreed

Musk confirmed that, at shareholders’ request, SpaceX and Tesla (TSLA‑US) each created a special committee of independent directors to assess a potential merger. He recused himself from negotiations due to a conflict of interest.

Musk believes the two firms could benefit from collaboration in AI software, chip design, Terafab, robotics and satellite communications, but no transaction terms have been agreed and the merger should not be considered a done deal.
According to Musk, Tesla would need support from shareholders representing 50% of all shares—not just a simple majority of voting shares—making the approval threshold quite high.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre-Market Highlights: Micron Strike Tension Escalates, Export Orders Hit 19th Consecutive Red, Currency and Stock Sell-Offs Reappear
paras:
台股盤前要聞 

1.台灣美光(Micron)勞資爭議持續升溫，關鍵的勞資協商將於 22 日正式登場。美光台中工會當天將與資方展開第二次勞資調解；為表達堅定立場，桃園工會同步宣布將於同日發起「聲援式罷工」，要求公司針對員工最核心的「具體分潤制度」提出實質對案。
2.經濟部20日公布115年9月外銷訂單統計，受惠AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求持續強勁，加上消費性電子新品陸續上市帶動拉貨動能，9月外銷訂單金額高達1,142.1億美元，較上月大幅增加112.5億美元或10.9%，與去年同月相比更爆增438.7億美元，年增率攀升至62.4%。8、9月更是連續2個月衝破千億美元大關，刷新連續19個月正成長紀錄。
3.股匯雙殺再現，三大法人20日合計賣超台股968.04億元，外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元終場收在32.617元，重貶1.72角，成交金額達32.77億美元；元太外匯市場成交金額為9.995億美元。兩大外匯市場今日成交金額合計高達 42.765 億美元，顯示在熱錢急退與避險結匯需求湧現下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
4.在AI伺服器及高速光通訊需求持續擴張下，臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)除積極擴充高階產品產能外，也加碼投資泰國及中國大陸，興建新廠，並加速布局光模組相關應用。隨著800G、1.6T等高速光通訊技術持續升級，臻鼎-KY光模組相關業務2027年可望呈現倍數成長；同時，隨著高階HDI及IC載板業務快速擴張，集團預期2028年HDI營收比重將超越軟板，2030年軟板營收占比則將降至30%以下。
5.是方(6561-TW)中科虎尾AI資料中心20日舉辦動土典禮，總經理劉耀元指出，是方中科虎尾AI資料中心將於2028年下半年啟用商轉，挑戰預約率達8至9成，目標在2031年開始獲利。

paras_en: 1. Micron (Taiwan) labor dispute intensifies, with key negotiations slated for the 22nd. The Taichung union will hold a second mediation session with management that day, while the Taoyuan union will simultaneously announce a "supportive strike" to demand a concrete profit‑sharing system for employees.

2. On the 20th, the Ministry of Economic Affairs released September export order statistics for 2025. Driven by strong demand for AI, high‑performance computing, and cloud services, and bolstered by new consumer electronics launches, September export orders reached US$114.21 billion, up US$11.25 billion or 10.9% from the previous month, and up US$43.87 billion or 62.4% year‑over‑year. August and September each surpassed the US$100 billion mark, extending a 19‑month streak of positive growth.

3. Dual sell‑offs in stocks and currency reemerged. Institutional investors sold a total of NT$96.804 billion in Taiwanese stocks on the 20th, with foreign and mainland investors accounting for NT$79.54 billion. The Taipei foreign exchange market closed the New Taiwan Dollar at US$32.617, a depreciation of 1.72 cents, with a trading volume of US$3.277 billion; the Yuan‑Taiwan market traded US$999.5 million. Combined, the two markets saw US$4.2765 billion in volume, reflecting a surge in hot‑money flight and hedging demand.

4. Amid expanding demand for AI servers and high‑speed optical communications, Zen‑Ding KY (4958‑TW) is boosting high‑tier product capacity and investing in new plants in Thailand and mainland China, while accelerating its optical module strategy. With 800 Gb/s and 1.6 Tb/s technologies upgrading, Zen‑Ding KY’s optical module business is expected to grow exponentially by 2027. Meanwhile, as high‑tier HDI and IC substrate businesses expand rapidly, the group anticipates HDI revenue will surpass that of soft‑board by 2028, and soft‑board revenue will fall below 30% by 2030.

5. Is‑Fang (6561‑TW) announced the groundbreaking ceremony for its Zhongke Hu‑wei AI data center on the 20th. General Manager Liu Yao‑yuan said the center will commence commercial operations in the second half of 2028, targeting an 80‑90% occupancy rate and aiming to become profitable by 2031.
6. Micron strike crisis escalates in Taiwan! Taichung and Taoyuan unions mobilize simultaneously, with the 22nd set for a critical mediation.
7. Export orders hit 19th consecutive red! September orders at US$114.2 billion, 62% year‑over‑year growth, likely to break the trillion mark this year.
8. New Taiwan Dollar sees foreign investors withdraw stocks and currency, briefly depreciating 2.27 cents and falling below the NT$32.6 threshold.
9. Zen‑Ding KY accelerates high‑tier hard‑board and HDI product strategy; HDI revenue share expected to exceed soft‑board by 2028.
10. Is‑Fang Zhongke Hu‑wei AI data center targets 80‑90% occupancy, aiming for profitability in 2031.
11. Taiwanese stocks shrink and oscillate, falling 529 points to revisit the seasonal line; electronic manufacturing and cooling resist downward pressure.
12. Taiwanese stocks revisit seasonal line; foreign investors continue selling NT$79.5 billion, a 10th consecutive sell, while turning back to buy electronic manufacturing shares.
13. Dongyuan pushes AIDC cooling and commercial air‑conditioning opportunities; next year’s revenue mix aims to exceed 60% of total.
14. CPC Jinghua City syndicated loan approved for a one‑year extension; next year will repay NT$1 billion in two installments.
15. DBS Economic Outlook: bullish on Taiwan’s AI supply chain moat, forecasting a 11.6% annual growth rate for the year.
16. Starry Direct to Prague: optimistic about Q4 and first half of next year’s growth at 40%, but concerned about oil price volatility.
17. Dongtai TPCA Show 2026 showcases unmanned drilling solutions; order visibility reaches until the end of 2027.

items.title: 星巴克「消費才能入座」？中國有門市已收到通知！
items.title_en: Starbucks “Only Paying Customers May Sit”? Some Chinese Stores Have Already Been Notified!
paras: 中國網上19日（周一）晚間傳出星巴克(SBUX-US) 20日起將實施「消費方可入座」的規定，星巴克中國顧客關懷中心對此表示，歡迎所有顧客到門市體驗，若有消費的顧客找不到座位，門市夥伴會去和未消費顧客溝通。
這場爭議源於一組星巴克門市物料照片。照片顯示，一張題為《星巴克「第三空間」倡議》的海報提出，希望顧客合理使用座位與公共區域，控制交談音量，共同維護友好公共環境。
配套桌牌上的提示則更加直接：「星巴克營業空間，請消費入座。」
「已經收到消費入座的口頭通知。」星巴克廣州寺右新馬路店店員20日稱，消費入座不是強制，只是一個提倡，「不消費坐一下是可以的，但是如果有別的顧客就是點了餐，他們沒有位置的話，可能就需要去調整一下，肯定要優先給消費的顧客入座。」
廣州其他星巴克門市則表示，沒收到上級有關消費入座的提示。
據《南方日報》報導，顧客對此有不同看法。有顧客認為，星巴克長期以來將開放的「第三空間」（指家庭和工作之外能放鬆社交的公共場所）作為品牌特色，如果開始限制未消費顧客入座，可能與經營理念產生衝突。
也有不少顧客認為，相對低的「門檻」，也容易催生一些亂象。比如，有人不消費長時間佔用座位，還有人桌面堆滿私人物品、隨手留下垃圾。門市的座位、保潔、水電，都是實實在在的經營成本。當這些資源被無償佔用，真正花錢消費的顧客反倒無座可坐。品牌適時調整規則，優先保障付費消費者的體驗，的確無可厚非。
不少星巴克門市強調，規則並非一刀切，外賣騎手、躲雨路人、孕婦、值班安保，有短暫休息需要，依舊可以免費進店歇腳。
paras_en: On the evening of Monday, October 19, reports surfaced online in China that Starbucks (SBUX-US) will implement a “pay‑to‑sit” rule starting October 20. Starbucks China’s customer care center said it welcomes all customers to visit its stores, and if a paying customer cannot find a seat, staff will speak with non‑paying customers to resolve the issue.

The controversy stems from a set of store‑level materials. The photos show a poster titled “Starbucks ‘Third Place’ Initiative” that asks customers to use seats and public areas responsibly, keep conversation volume moderate, and help maintain a friendly public environment.
The accompanying tabletop sign is more direct: “Starbucks retail space – please sit only after purchasing.”

“We’ve already received a verbal notice about the pay‑to‑sit policy,” said an employee at the Guangzhou Siyi Xinma Road store on the 20th. He clarified that the rule is not mandatory but a recommendation: “You can sit without ordering, but if another customer has placed an order and there’s no seat available, we may need to adjust, and paying customers will be given priority.”
Other Starbucks locations in Guangzhou said they have not received any guidance from higher‑ups regarding the pay‑to‑sit policy.

According to the Southern Daily, customers have mixed reactions. Some argue that Starbucks has long marketed its open “third place” – a public space for relaxation and socializing outside home and work – as a core brand feature, and restricting non‑paying patrons could clash with that philosophy.

Others point out that a low barrier to sitting can create problems. Some people occupy seats for long periods without buying, pile personal items on tables, or leave trash behind. Seating, cleaning, water and electricity are real operating costs. When these resources are used for free, paying customers may find no seats. Adjusting the rule to protect paying customers’ experience is therefore understandable.

Many Starbucks stores emphasize that the rule is not applied uniformly. Takeout riders, people seeking shelter from rain, pregnant women, and on‑duty security staff who need a brief rest are still allowed to enter and sit for free.

items.title: 美股道瓊大漲530點！資金轉進醫療保健股，AI投資疑慮拖累科技股
items.title_en: US Stocks: Dow Surges 530 Points as Funds Flow into Healthcare; AI Investment Concerns Drag Down Tech Shares
paras: 2026年10月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股周二(20日)漲跌互見，道瓊工業指數大漲529.85點、漲幅1.02%，標普500指數上漲0.28%，那斯達克指數則小跌0.02%。市場對人工智慧(AI)龐大資本支出及獲利回收能力仍存疑慮，資金轉向醫療保健及小型股，帶動道瓊表現優於科技股為主的那斯達克指數。
道瓊工業指數收52,495.88點，上漲529.85點；標普500指數收7,712.57點，上漲21.84點；那斯達克指數收26,424.82點，下跌6.07點。小型股羅素2000指數上漲1.7%，標普500價值股指數上漲0.9%，成長股指數則下跌0.2%，反映市場資金輪動。
醫療保健類股成為當日主要上漲動能，標普500醫療保健指數創下歷史新高。禮來Eli Lilly(LLY-US)為標普500指數貢獻最多漲點的個股，聯合健康UnitedHealth(UNH-US)、默克Merck(MRK-US)及嬌生Johnson & Johnson(JNJ-US)也帶動道瓊走高。
相較之下，科技類股下跌0.3%，成為拖累標普500指數的主要因素。Plante Moran Financial Advisors投資長Jim Baird指出，投資人仍擔心AI企業能否將龐大資本支出轉化為獲利，因此開始尋找科技股以外的機會，醫療保健與小型股成為主要受惠族群。
個股方面，3M(MMM-US)大漲5.8%，受惠擴大與亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)的資料中心合作，並上調全年獲利預測；孩之寶Hasbro(HAS-US)因數位遊戲需求強勁、調升全年財測，股價大漲11.2%。Equifax(EFX-US)財報優於預期，股價上漲11.3%，通用汽車General Motors(GM-US)則因原物料成本上升及卡車銷售壓力，下跌6.8%。

The company posted revenue of about $11.1 billion and a margin of 17.5% in the previous quarter; the midpoint of this quarter’s revenue estimate reaches $19.0 billion, a roughly 71% sequential increase, yet the margin stays below the prior quarter’s level, showing that the expanding AI server shipments have not yet translated into a comparable profit‑margin recovery.

Supermicro emphasized that the figures released are unaudited preliminary estimates and the final results will be confirmed after the close of the accounting period. paras_en: On October 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) SpaceX released its Q3 2026 financial results, reporting revenue of $14.575 billion, up 161% year‑over‑year, and operating profit of $2.791 billion, a swing from a loss of $273 million in the same quarter last year. The artificial intelligence (AI) segment, now renamed Super Intelligence (SI), generated $7.560 billion in revenue, up 830% year‑over‑year, accounting for roughly 52% of group revenue and overtaking the communications segment that houses Starlink for the first time.

The SI segment’s revenue growth stemmed mainly from the start of new cloud‑service contracts, increased adoption of Grok by enterprises and consumers, and the contribution from the acquisition of the programming‑tool company Cursor. AI solutions and infrastructure revenue reached $7.022 billion, while advertising revenue was $538 million; Cursor, acquired on August 14, added $608 million of revenue by quarter‑end. As the business scaled, the SI segment turned from an operating loss of $1.722 billion in the prior year’s quarter to an operating profit of $431 million.

Nevertheless, Starlink remains the group’s primary profit driver. The communications segment posted Q3 revenue of $5.248 billion, up 69% year‑over‑year, and operating profit of $2.367 billion, up 99% year‑over‑year. Enterprise and government revenue grew 91% year‑over‑year, outpacing consumer revenue growth of 57%; Starlink consumer subscriptions reached 13.6 million at quarter‑end, an increase of 1.6 million from the previous quarter, indicating continued user expansion and enterprise demand supporting communications growth.

The rapid expansion of the AI business also drove massive capital spending. SpaceX’s Q3 capital expenditures totaled $19.593 billion, with $16.444 billion allocated to the SI segment, roughly 84% of the total. As the Colossus II facility continues to expand, SI’s compute capacity rose from 1.4 GW in the prior quarter to 1.7 GW, reflecting the company’s accelerated build‑out of AI infrastructure.

It is noteworthy that SpaceX generated $13.097 billion of operating cash flow in the first three quarters, but spent $48.069 billion on property, plant and equipment, indicating that existing operating cash flow is insufficient to fund the expansion. With AI becoming the largest revenue source, market focus will shift from high‑speed revenue growth to whether compute investments can sustain profitability and generate adequate cash flow.

paras: 2026年10月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)與SpaceX共同推動的Terafab晶片製造計畫，正式訂出量產時程。馬斯克20日在SpaceX財報電話會議上表示，目標於2028年第三季啟動量產，並計畫2027年5月至6月先完成首顆SRAM測試晶片。不過，他坦言時程相當積極，仍存在高度不確定性，無法保證如期達成。
Terafab將以德州奧斯汀研發廠為起點，先透過SRAM測試晶片驗證製造技術。SRAM為靜態隨機存取記憶體，半導體業常以其測試電路檢驗製程是否穩定，因此明年能否成功製造出可正常運作的晶片，將是Terafab邁向量產的重要里程碑，但距離正式供應AI運算晶片仍有一段距離。
Terafab計畫整合先進邏輯晶片、記憶體製造，以及封裝與測試，目標建立服務AI與機器人運算需求的半導體製造基地。不過，先進晶圓廠建設涉及複雜設備與製程開發。美國先進邏輯晶圓廠興建通常可能耗時三年以上，還需要一兩年的良率爬坡，Terafab若要在2028年第三季量產，仍須克服設備交付、產線建置及製程驗證等挑戰。
其中，荷蘭半導體設備大廠艾司摩爾ASML(ASML-US)的極紫外光(EUV)微影設備成為市場關注焦點。當分析師詢問是否已向ASML下訂設備時，馬斯克並未直接回答，僅感謝ASML及其他供應商加速交付，顯示關鍵設備採購進度仍有待進一步確認。
此外，英特爾Intel(INTC-US)今年4月已宣布參與Terafab計畫，但雙方尚未公開具體合作方式。隨著Terafab訂出2027年製程驗證、2028年量產的目標，後續能否如期取得設備、完成測試晶片並建立穩定製程，將成為觀察這項半導體製造計畫能否落實的關鍵。

paras_en: October 21, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The Terafab chip manufacturing project jointly driven by Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX has officially set a mass‑production timeline. Elon Musk said in SpaceX’s earnings call on the 20th that the goal is to start volume production in Q3 2028 and to complete the first SRAM test chip between May and June 2027. However, he admitted the schedule is very aggressive, carries high uncertainty, and cannot be guaranteed to be met on time.

Terafab will start at its R&D facility in Austin, Texas, using an SRAM test chip to validate the manufacturing technology. SRAM, static random‑access memory, is commonly used in the semiconductor industry to test circuit stability, so whether a functional chip can be produced next year will be a key milestone for Terafab’s path to volume production, though there remains a gap before it can supply AI compute chips.

Terafab plans to integrate advanced logic chips, memory manufacturing, and packaging and testing to create a semiconductor manufacturing hub serving AI and robotics workloads. However, building an advanced wafer fab involves complex equipment and process development. In the United States, constructing an advanced logic fab typically takes three years or more, plus one to two years of yield ramp‑up. To hit Q3 2028 volume production, Terafab still must overcome equipment delivery, line construction, and process validation challenges.

Among the critical items, the extreme‑ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment from Dutch semiconductor equipment giant ASML (ASML-US) has become a market focus. When analysts asked whether orders had been placed with ASML, Musk did not answer directly, only thanking ASML and other suppliers for accelerating deliveries, indicating that the procurement status of key equipment remains to be confirmed.

In addition, Intel (INTC-US) announced in April this year that it would join the Terafab project, but the two parties have not disclosed the specifics of their collaboration. With Terafab setting goals for process validation in 2027 and mass production in 2028, the ability to secure equipment, complete test chips and establish a stable process on schedule will be the key to assessing whether the semiconductor manufacturing plan can be realized.

items.title: AI資料中心用電成本誰買單？Google自掏腰包擴建電網 帶動6億美元電力投資
items.title_en: Who Pays for AI Data Center Power Costs? Google Funds Grid Expansion, Driving $600 Million Power Investment
paras: 2026年10月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨著AI資料中心用電需求快速攀升，美國各地開始擔心，大型科技公司擴建算力設施，是否會推高一般民眾的電費。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)則選擇自行負擔新增供電成本。美國電力公司Entergy(ETR-US)19日宣布，雙方將擴大阿肯色州西孟菲斯資料中心合作，規劃約6億美元電力基礎設施投資，Google不僅承擔新增供電設施的全部成本，也將在20年合約期間分攤既有電網固定支出，避免將資料中心擴建成本轉嫁給一般用戶。
這項合作反映AI資料中心面臨的新挑戰。過去科技公司擴建資料中心，主要關注伺服器、晶片及運算設備，如今隨著用電規模擴大，電力供應是否充足、電網能否承受新增負載，以及建設成本由誰負擔，正成為影響資料中心投資的重要因素。
Google早在2025年10月便宣布，計畫於2027年前投入40億美元，在阿肯色州興建雲端與AI資料中心。隨著園區進一步擴建，原有供電規模也必須同步提升，因此Google與Entergy展開第二階段合作，將投資範圍從電力採購擴大至太陽能、電池儲能、變電站及輸電線路。

根據最新規劃，Entergy將在Driver Solar附近興建1,000MWh電池儲能系統，並於Hot Springs附近新增400MWh儲能設備，合計1,400MWh，同時擴建Galet變電站、興建兩條230kV輸電線路，另新增440MW太陽能購電協議，由Big Island電廠供應。連同先前規劃的能源設施，整體新增資源將超過1GW太陽能及2,800MWh電池儲能，相關新設施預計2028年投入服務。
這些設備各自扮演不同角色。太陽能提供新增電力來源，儲能系統提高供電調度彈性，變電站與輸電線則負責將電力送往資料中心。對需要長時間穩定運作的AI資料中心而言，單純增加發電量已不足以滿足需求，還必須同步強化儲能及電網輸送能力。
值得注意的是，Google自行負擔新增供電成本，也有助於降低當地居民對電價上漲的疑慮。Entergy估計，第二階段合作自2028年起，未來20年可為其他用戶節省至少5億美元。不過，這項效益仍屬公司預估，相關擴建計畫及新增太陽能購電安排，也須取得阿肯色州公共服務委員會核准。

paras_en: October 21, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – As AI data center electricity demand soars, U.S. regions are worrying that large tech firms expanding compute capacity could push up residential electricity bills. Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent, has chosen to shoulder the cost of additional power itself. On the 19th, U.S. utility Entergy (ETR-US) announced that the two will expand their West Memphis, Arkansas data‑center partnership, planning roughly $600 million in power‑infrastructure investment. Google will cover the full cost of new supply facilities and, over a 20‑year contract, share existing grid fixed expenses to avoid passing expansion costs onto ordinary users.

This partnership reflects new challenges facing AI data centers. In the past, tech companies expanding data centers focused on servers, chips and compute equipment; now, as electricity use balloons, the adequacy of power supply, the grid’s ability to handle added load, and who bears construction costs are becoming key factors influencing data‑center investment.

Google announced in October 2025 that it plans to invest $4 billion by 2027 to build cloud and AI data centers in Arkansas. As the campus expands further, the original power capacity must be upgraded in tandem, prompting Google and Entergy to launch a second‑phase collaboration that widens the investment scope from power procurement to solar, battery storage, substations and transmission lines.

Under the latest plan, Entergy will build a 1,000 MWh battery storage system near Driver Solar and add another 400 MWh of storage near Hot Springs, totaling 1,400 MWh. It will also expand the Galet substation, construct two 230 kV transmission lines, and add a 440 MW solar power purchase agreement supplied by the Big Island plant. Combined with previously planned energy assets, the overall new resources will exceed 1 GW of solar and 2,800 MWh of battery storage, with the new facilities slated to enter service in 2028.

These assets each play distinct roles. Solar provides new generation capacity, storage systems boost dispatch flexibility, and substations and transmission lines deliver power to the data center. For AI data centers that require long‑running, stable operation, merely adding generation is insufficient; storage and grid transmission capabilities must be strengthened simultaneously.

Notably, Google’s decision to fund the additional power costs also helps allay local residents’ concerns about rising electricity rates. Entergy estimates that the second‑phase collaboration, starting in 2028, could save other users at least $500 million over the next 20 years. However, this benefit remains a company estimate, and the expansion plans and new solar purchase agreements still require approval from the Arkansas Public Service Commission.

items.title: 美光震盪收黑 AI投資疑慮升溫、韓國新股慘跌與桃園罷工添壓力
items.title_en: Micron Slides as AI Investment Concerns Rise, Korean IPO Crashes, and Taoyuan Strike Adds Pressure
paras: 美光(Micron)(MU-US)周二(20日)股價一度走高，但終場仍無法收在平盤之上，三大警訊正壟罩在記憶體族群的頭頂。
美光周二終場下跌0.98%，前一交易日上漲3%。
近期晶片股承受沉重賣壓。先前受人工智慧(AI)熱潮推升、估值已大幅拉高的晶片股，如今受到另一項疑慮衝擊：為了擴建AI基礎設施，企業所需承擔的債務不斷增加。
記憶體股周二也走低，SanDisk(SNDK-US)周二下跌0.4%，SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)股價走勢則更顯疲態，在那斯達克交易的股票下跌1.5%。SK海力士在南韓掛牌的股票周二稍早收盤下跌4.2%，創4月中旬以來最低水準。
南韓市場的最新消息，進一步加深投資人對AI產業的疑慮：雲端基礎設施業者Elice備受期待的首次公開發行(IPO)在首爾市場表現失利，掛牌首日股價重挫超過30%。
美光本周也可能面臨罷工風險，代表美光台灣桃園員工的工會表示，因員工獎金爭議，將於本周四發動罷工。桃園是美光最重要的製造據點之一。
巴隆周刊(Barron's)表示，美光9月也曾面臨罷工疑慮，但當時股價成功消化相關利空，這次或許也能再次挺過考驗。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) saw its stock rise briefly on Tuesday (the 20th) but closed below the opening price, with three major warning signs looming over the memory‑chip sector.
Micron ended Tuesday down 0.98% after having risen 3% the previous trading day.

Chip stocks have recently been under heavy selling pressure. After being propelled higher by the AI boom and seeing valuations surge, they are now hit by another worry: companies need to take on increasing debt to expand AI infrastructure.

Memory stocks also fell on Tuesday, with SanDisk (SNDK-US) down 0.4% and SK Hynix (SKHY-US) showing even weaker performance, slipping 1.5% on the Nasdaq. SK Hynix’s shares listed in South Korea fell 4.2% earlier in the day, hitting their lowest level since mid‑April.

The latest news from the South Korean market deepens investors’ doubts about the AI industry: cloud‑infrastructure provider Elice’s highly anticipated IPO performed poorly on the Seoul exchange, with the debut price plunging more than 30% on the first day.

Micron may also face strike risk this week, as the union representing Micron’s Taoyuan, Taiwan employees announced a strike on Thursday over a bonus dispute. Taoyuan is one of Micron’s most important manufacturing sites.
Barron’s noted that Micron faced strike concerns in September, but the stock then absorbed the negative news; it may be able to weather this challenge again.

items.title: AI代理當臥底 引誘詐騙分子上鉤 新創公司獲近1,000萬美元融資
items.title_en: AI Agents Go Undercover to Lure Scammers; Startup Secures Nearly $10 Million Funding
paras: 據《TechCrunch》報導，澳洲新創公司Apate正在使用AI代理應對電信詐騙，通過浪費騙子時間、獲取詐騙訊息等方式，阻止潛在詐騙。
這家澳洲公司成立於2024年，源於麥覺理大學（Macquarie University）的一項研究。Apate部署了數千個偽裝成無辜受害者的AI代理。
這些AI代理可以接聽詐騙電話、回覆可疑簡訊和電子郵件、點擊釣魚連結、加入社交媒體群組，引誘詐騙分子上鉤。
AI代理會偽裝成形形色色的人，有著不同的年齡、性別和口音，並能說多種語言，試圖盡可能拖住騙子，從而套取出有用訊息。
Apate表示，目前其AI代理大軍已在250萬次對話中累計浪費了騙子17年時間。
對Apate用戶而言，更重要的是，這些臥底AI代理會設法誘使騙子吐露一些通常只有在受害者被騙後才能掌握的訊息：銀行賬戶、加密貨幣錢包、電話號碼、惡意網站、他們所冒充的品牌。
作為今年TechCrunch Disrupt大會「創業競技場200強」（Startup Battlefield 200）的決賽入圍者之一，Apate會將這些訊息提供給客戶，供其制定和完善反詐措施與行動方案。
這是「反詐騙」的一種奇妙演變，但考慮到AI在很大程度上助長了詐騙分子和駭客氣焰，這也不令人意外。美國聯邦調查局（FBI）2025年接到超過2.2萬起與AI相關的犯罪投訴，造成的損失約8.93億美元，其中超過6.32億美元屬於投資詐騙。
FBI表示，在這類騙局中，欺詐者會利用AI進行對話，偽造名人、企業高層和受信任人士的聲音與外貌。
今年8月，Apate獲得由Lobby Capital、OIF Ventures、Investible、Concept Ventures和Baobab Ventures投資的815萬美元種子輪融資。
這家由20名員工組成的公司，累計融資額接近1,000萬美元。Apate計劃將最新一輪資金用於產品研發和國際擴張，包括在倫敦設立辦事處，以及擴大在美國的業務布局。
paras_en: According to TechCrunch, Australian startup Apate is using AI agents to combat telecom fraud by wasting scammers' time, gathering scam messages, and preventing potential fraud.
The Australian company, founded in 2024, originated from a research project at Macquarie University. Apate has deployed thousands of AI agents masquerading as innocent victims.
These AI agents can answer scam calls, reply to suspicious texts and emails, click phishing links, and join social‑media groups, luring scammers into the trap.

The AI agents disguise themselves as a variety of people with different ages, genders, accents, and can speak multiple languages, trying to keep scammers occupied as long as possible to extract useful information.
Apate says its army of AI agents has so far wasted scammers' time by a cumulative 17 years across 2.5 million conversations.

For Apate’s customers, the undercover AI agents also manage to coax scammers into revealing information that victims typically only know after being defrauded: bank accounts, cryptocurrency wallets, phone numbers, malicious websites, and the brands they impersonate.
As a finalist in this year’s TechCrunch Disrupt Startup Battlefield 200, Apate will provide these data to clients to help them devise and refine anti‑fraud measures and response plans.

It is a curious evolution of anti‑fraud tactics, but not surprising given that AI has largely empowered scammers and hackers. The FBI received more than 22,000 AI‑related crime complaints in 2025, resulting in losses of about $893 million, over $632 million of which stemmed from investment fraud.
The FBI says that in such schemes fraudsters use AI to conduct conversations and to fabricate the voices and appearances of celebrities, corporate executives, and trusted individuals.
In August this year, Apate secured a $8.15 million seed round from Lobby Capital, OIF Ventures, Investible, Concept Ventures and Baobab Ventures.

The 20‑person company has raised close to $10 million in total. Apate plans to use the latest funding for product development and international expansion, including opening an office in London and scaling its U.S. operations.

items.title: 星巴克「消費才能入座」？中國有門市已收到通知！
items.title_en: Starbucks “Only Paying Customers May Sit”? Some Chinese Stores Have Already Been Notified!
paras: 中國網上19日（周一）晚間傳出星巴克(SBUX-US) 20日起將實施「消費方可入座」的規定，星巴克中國顧客關懷中心對此表示，歡迎所有顧客到門市體驗，若有消費的顧客找不到座位，門市夥伴會去和未消費顧客溝通。
這場爭議源於一組星巴克門市物料照片。照片顯示，一張題為《星巴克「第三空間」倡議》的海報提出，希望顧客合理使用座位與公共區域，控制交談音量，共同維護友好公共環境。
配套桌牌上的提示則更加直接：「星巴克營業空間，請消費入座。」
「已經收到消費入座的口頭通知。」星巴克廣州寺右新馬路店店員20日稱，消費入座不是強制，只是一個提倡，「不消費坐一下是可以的，但是如果有別的顧客就是點了餐，他們沒有位置的話，可能就需要去調整一下，肯定要優先給消費的顧客入座。」
廣州其他星巴克門市則表示，沒收到上級有關消費入座的提示。
據《南方日報》報導，顧客對此有不同看法。有顧客認為，星巴克長期以來將開放的「第三空間」（指家庭和工作之外能放鬆社交的公共場所）作為品牌特色，如果開始限制未消費顧客入座，可能與經營理念產生衝突。
也有不少顧客認為，相對低的「門檻」，也容易催生一些亂象。比如，有人不消費長時間佔用座位，還有人桌面堆滿私人物品、隨手留下垃圾。門市的座位、保潔、水電，都是實實在在的經營成本。當這些資源被無償佔用，真正花錢消費的顧客反倒無座可坐。品牌適時調整規則，優先保障付費消費者的體驗，的確無可厚非。
不少星巴克門市強調，規則並非一刀切，外賣騎手、躲雨路人、孕婦、值班安保，有短暫休息需要，依舊可以免費進店歇腳。
paras_en: On the evening of Monday, October 19, reports surfaced online in China that Starbucks (SBUX-US) will implement a “pay‑to‑sit” rule starting October 20. Starbucks China’s customer care center said it welcomes all customers to visit its stores, and if a paying customer cannot find a seat, staff will speak with non‑paying customers to resolve the issue.

The controversy stems from a set of store‑level materials. The photos show a poster titled “Starbucks ‘Third Place’ Initiative” that asks customers to use seats and public areas responsibly, keep conversation volume moderate, and help maintain a friendly public environment.
The accompanying tabletop sign is more direct: “Starbucks retail space – please sit only after purchasing.”

“We’ve already received a verbal notice about the pay‑to‑sit policy,” said an employee at the Guangzhou Siyi Xinma Road store on the 20th. He clarified that the rule is not mandatory but a recommendation: “You can sit without ordering, but if another customer has placed an order and there’s no seat available, we may need to adjust, and paying customers will be given priority.”
Other Starbucks locations in Guangzhou said they have not received any guidance from higher‑ups regarding the pay‑to‑sit policy.

According to the Southern Daily, customers have mixed reactions. Some argue that Starbucks has long marketed its open “third place” – a public space for relaxation and socializing outside home and work – as a core brand feature, and restricting non‑paying patrons could clash with that philosophy.

Others point out that a low barrier to sitting can create problems. Some people occupy seats for long periods without buying, pile personal items on tables, or leave trash behind. Seating, cleaning, water and electricity are real operating costs. When these resources are used for free, paying customers may find no seats. Adjusting the rule to protect paying customers’ experience is therefore understandable.

Many Starbucks stores emphasize that the rule is not applied uniformly. Takeout riders, people seeking shelter from rain, pregnant women, and on‑duty security staff who need a brief rest are still allowed to enter and sit for free.

items.title: 美股道瓊大漲530點！資金轉進醫療保健股，AI投資疑慮拖累科技股
items.title_en: US Stocks: Dow Surges 530 Points as Funds Flow into Healthcare; AI Investment Concerns Drag Down Tech Shares
paras: 2026年10月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股周二(20日)漲跌互見，道瓊工業指數大漲529.85點、漲幅1.02%，標普500指數上漲0.28%，那斯達克指數則小跌0.02%。市場對人工智慧(AI)龐大資本支出及獲利回收能力仍存疑慮，資金轉向醫療保健及小型股，帶動道瓊表現優於科技股為主的那斯達克指數。
道瓊工業指數收52,495.88點，上漲529.85點；標普500指數收7,712.57點，上漲21.84點；那斯達克指數收26,424.82點，下跌6.07點。小型股羅素2000指數上漲1.7%，標普500價值股指數上漲0.9%，成長股指數則下跌0.2%，反映市場資金輪動。
醫療保健類股成為當日主要上漲動能，標普500醫療保健指數創下歷史新高。禮來Eli Lilly(LLY-US)為標普500指數貢獻最多漲點的個股，聯合健康UnitedHealth(UNH-US)、默克Merck(MRK-US)及嬌生Johnson & Johnson(JNJ-US)也帶動道瓊走高。
相較之下，科技類股下跌0.3%，成為拖累標普500指數的主要因素。Plante Moran Financial Advisors投資長Jim Baird指出，投資人仍擔心AI企業能否將龐大資本支出轉化為獲利，因此開始尋找科技股以外的機會，醫療保健與小型股成為主要受惠族群。
個股方面，3M(MMM-US)大漲5.8%，受惠擴大與亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)的資料中心合作，並上調全年獲利預測；孩之寶Hasbro(HAS-US)因數位遊戲需求強勁、調升全年財測，股價大漲11.2%。Equifax(EFX-US)財報優於預期，股價上漲11.3%，通用汽車General Motors(GM-US)則因原物料成本上升及卡車銷售壓力，下跌6.8%。
大型科技股表現疲弱，Netflix(NFLX-US)、Meta(META-US)及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)分別下跌1.7%、1.6%及1%，拖累通訊服務類股下跌0.9%。盤後Netflix公布的第四季獲利展望不如預期，股價進一步下挫6%；SpaceX(SPCX-US)則因第三季獲利優於預期，盤後上漲4%。
整體而言，美股資金並未全面撤出市場，而是從AI投資回報仍具不確定性的科技股，轉向醫療保健、金融及防禦型類股。隨著Meta與特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)即將公布財報，市場將持續關注大型科技企業的獲利表現與AI資本支出動向。

paras_en: On Tuesday, October 20, 2026, U.S. equities showed mixed moves: the Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 529.85 points, up 1.02%, the S&P 500 rose 0.28%, while the Nasdaq slipped 0.02%. Doubts remain about the massive capital spending and profit‑recovery potential of artificial‑intelligence (AI) firms, prompting money to shift toward healthcare and small‑cap stocks, which helped the Dow outperform the tech‑heavy Nasdaq.

The Dow closed at 52,495.88, up 529.85 points; the S&P 500 ended at 7,712.57, up 21.84 points; the Nasdaq finished at 26,424.82, down 6.07 points. The Russell 2000 small‑cap index rose 1.7%, the S&P 500 value‑stock index gained 0.9%, while the growth‑stock index fell 0.2%, reflecting a rotation of capital across sectors.

Healthcare stocks led the day's gains, with the S&P 500 Healthcare Index hitting a record high. Eli Lilly (LLY‑US) contributed the most points to the S&P 500, while UnitedHealth (UNH‑US), Merck (MRK‑US) and Johnson & Johnson (JNJ‑US) also lifted the Dow.

In contrast, technology stocks fell 0.3%, becoming the main drag on the S&P 500. Jim Baird, chief investment officer at Plante Moran Financial Advisors, said investors remain uneasy about whether AI companies can turn their huge capex into profits, so they are seeking opportunities outside tech, with healthcare and small‑caps benefiting the most.

On the stock‑specific front, 3M (MMM‑US) surged 5.8% after expanding its data‑center partnership with Amazon (AMZN‑US) and raising its full‑year earnings outlook; Hasbro (HAS‑US) jumped 11.2% on strong digital‑game demand and an upgraded earnings forecast; Equifax (EFX‑US) rose 11.3% after beating earnings expectations; while General Motors (GM‑US) fell 6.8% amid higher material costs and pressure on truck sales.

Large‑cap tech names were weak: Netflix (NFLX‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) slipped 1.7%, 1.6% and 1.0% respectively, pulling down the communication‑services sector 0.9%. After hours, Netflix warned that its Q4 earnings outlook fell short of expectations, sending the stock down an additional 6%; SpaceX (SPCX‑US) rose 4% after reporting better‑than‑expected Q3 earnings.

Overall, U.S. equity money has not fled the market but has rotated from tech stocks—where AI investment returns remain uncertain—to healthcare, financials and defensive sectors. With Meta and Tesla (TSLA‑US) set to report earnings soon, the market will keep a close eye on big‑tech profitability and AI capex trends.

SI部門營收成長主要來自新雲端服務合約開始履行、企業與消費者增加採用Grok，以及收購程式開發工具Cursor的挹注。其中，AI解決方案與基礎設施營收達70.22億美元，廣告收入5.38億美元；8月14日完成收購的Cursor，自併入至季底貢獻6.08億美元營收。隨著業務規模擴大，SI部門也由去年同期營業虧損17.22億美元，轉為獲利4.31億美元。
不過，Starlink仍是集團主要獲利來源。通訊部門第三季營收52.48億美元、年增69%，營業利益23.67億美元、年增99%。其中企業與政府業務營收年增91%，高於消費者業務的57%；季底Starlink消費者訂戶達1,360萬戶，季增160萬戶，顯示用戶擴張與企業需求持續支撐通訊業務成長。

paras_en: On October 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) SpaceX released its Q3 2026 financial results, reporting revenue of $14.575 billion, up 161% year‑over‑year, and operating profit of $2.791 billion, a swing from a loss of $273 million in the same quarter last year. The artificial intelligence (AI) segment, now renamed Super Intelligence (SI), generated $7.560 billion in revenue, up 830% year‑over‑year, accounting for roughly 52% of group revenue and overtaking the communications segment that houses Starlink for the first time.

The SI segment’s revenue growth stemmed mainly from the start of new cloud‑service contracts, increased adoption of Grok by enterprises and consumers, and the contribution from the acquisition of the programming‑tool company Cursor. AI solutions and infrastructure revenue reached $7.022 billion, while advertising revenue was $538 million; Cursor, acquired on August 14, added $608 million of revenue by quarter‑end. As the business scaled, the SI segment turned from an operating loss of $1.722 billion in the prior year’s quarter to an operating profit of $431 million.

Nevertheless, Starlink remains the group’s primary profit driver. The communications segment posted Q3 revenue of $5.248 billion, up 69% year‑over‑year, and operating profit of $2.367 billion, up 99% year‑over‑year. Enterprise and government revenue grew 91% year‑over‑year, outpacing consumer revenue growth of 57%; Starlink consumer subscriptions reached 13.6 million at quarter‑end, an increase of 1.6 million from the previous quarter, indicating continued user expansion and enterprise demand supporting communications growth.

The rapid expansion of the AI business also drove massive capital spending. SpaceX’s Q3 capital expenditures totaled $19.593 billion, with $16.444 billion allocated to the SI segment, roughly 84% of the total. As the Colossus II facility continues to expand, SI’s compute capacity rose from 1.4 GW in the prior quarter to 1.7 GW, reflecting the company’s accelerated build‑out of AI infrastructure.

It is noteworthy that SpaceX generated $13.097 billion of operating cash flow in the first three quarters, but spent $48.069 billion on property, plant and equipment, indicating that existing operating cash flow is insufficient to fund the expansion. With AI becoming the largest revenue source, market focus will shift from high‑speed revenue growth to whether compute investments can sustain profitability and generate adequate cash flow.

items.title: 馬斯克自建晶片廠拚2028年量產！Terafab明年驗證製程，EUV設備交付成關鍵
items.title_en: Musk Builds Chip Fab Aiming for 2028 Mass Production! Terafab to Validate Process Next Year, EUV Equipment Delivery Key
paras: 2026年10月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)與SpaceX共同推動的Terafab晶片製造計畫，正式訂出量產時程。馬斯克20日在SpaceX財報電話會議上表示，目標於2028年第三季啟動量產，並計畫2027年5月至6月先完成首顆SRAM測試晶片。不過，他坦言時程相當積極，仍存在高度不確定性，無法保證如期達成。
Terafab將以德州奧斯汀研發廠為起點，先透過SRAM測試晶片驗證製造技術。SRAM為靜態隨機存取記憶體，半導體業常以其測試電路檢驗製程是否穩定，因此明年能否成功製造出可正常運作的晶片，將是Terafab邁向量產的重要里程碑，但距離正式供應AI運算晶片仍有一段距離。
Terafab計畫整合先進邏輯晶片、記憶體製造，以及封裝與測試，目標建立服務AI與機器人運算需求的半導體製造基地。不過，先進晶圓廠建設涉及複雜設備與製程開發。美國先進邏輯晶圓廠興建通常可能耗時三年以上，還需要一兩年的良率爬坡，Terafab若要在2028年第三季量產，仍須克服設備交付、產線建置及製程驗證等挑戰。
其中，荷蘭半導體設備大廠艾司摩爾ASML(ASML-US)的極紫外光(EUV)微影設備成為市場關注焦點。當分析師詢問是否已向ASML下訂設備時，馬斯克並未直接回答，僅感謝ASML及其他供應商加速交付，顯示關鍵設備採購進度仍有待進一步確認。
此外，英特爾Intel(INTC-US)今年4月已宣布參與Terafab計畫，但雙方尚未公開具體合作方式。隨著Terafab訂出2027年製程驗證、2028年量產的目標，後續能否如期取得設備、完成測試晶片並建立穩定製程，將成為觀察這項半導體製造計畫能否落實的關鍵。

paras_en: October 21, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The Terafab chip manufacturing project jointly driven by Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX has officially set a mass‑production timeline. Elon Musk said in SpaceX’s earnings call on the 20th that the goal is to start volume production in Q3 2028 and to complete the first SRAM test chip between May and June 2027. However, he admitted the schedule is very aggressive, carries high uncertainty, and cannot be guaranteed to be met on time.

Terafab will start at its R&D facility in Austin, Texas, using an SRAM test chip to validate the manufacturing technology. SRAM, static random‑access memory, is commonly used in the semiconductor industry to test circuit stability, so whether a functional chip can be produced next year will be a key milestone for Terafab’s path to volume production, though there remains a gap before it can supply AI compute chips.

Terafab plans to integrate advanced logic chips, memory manufacturing, and packaging and testing to create a semiconductor manufacturing hub serving AI and robotics workloads. However, building an advanced wafer fab involves complex equipment and process development. In the United States, constructing an advanced logic fab typically takes three years or more, plus one to two years of yield ramp‑up. To hit Q3 2028 volume production, Terafab still must overcome equipment delivery, line construction, and process validation challenges.

Among the critical items, the extreme‑ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment from Dutch semiconductor equipment giant ASML (ASML-US) has become a market focus. When analysts asked whether orders had been placed with ASML, Musk did not answer directly, only thanking ASML and other suppliers for accelerating deliveries, indicating that the procurement status of key equipment remains to be confirmed.

In addition, Intel (INTC-US) announced in April this year that it would join the Terafab project, but the two parties have not disclosed the specifics of their collaboration. With Terafab setting goals for process validation in 2027 and mass production in 2028, the ability to secure equipment, complete test chips and establish a stable process on schedule will be the key to assessing whether the semiconductor manufacturing plan can be realized.

items.title: AI資料中心用電成本誰買單？Google自掏腰包擴建電網 帶動6億美元電力投資
items.title_en: Who Pays for AI Data Center Power Costs? Google Funds Grid Expansion, Driving $600 Million Power Investment
paras: 2026年10月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨著AI資料中心用電需求快速攀升，美國各地開始擔心，大型科技公司擴建算力設施，是否會推高一般民眾的電費。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)則選擇自行負擔新增供電成本。美國電力公司Entergy(ETR-US)19日宣布，雙方將擴大阿肯色州西孟菲斯資料中心合作，規劃約6億美元電力基礎設施投資，Google不僅承擔新增供電設施的全部成本，也將在20年合約期間分攤既有電網固定支出，避免將資料中心擴建成本轉嫁給一般用戶。
這項合作反映AI資料中心面臨的新挑戰。過去科技公司擴建資料中心，主要關注伺服器、晶片及運算設備，如今隨著用電規模擴大，電力供應是否充足、電網能否承受新增負載，以及建設成本由誰負擔，正成為影響資料中心投資的重要因素。
Google早在2025年10月便宣布，計畫於2027年前投入40億美元，在阿肯色州興建雲端與AI資料中心。隨著園區進一步擴建，原有供電規模也必須同步提升，因此Google與Entergy展開第二階段合作，將投資範圍從電力採購擴大至太陽能、電池儲能、變電站及輸電線路。

根據最新規劃，Entergy將在Driver Solar附近興建1,000MWh電池儲能系統，並於Hot Springs附近新增400MWh儲能設備，合計1,400MWh，同時擴建Galet變電站、興建兩條230kV輸電線路，另新增440MW太陽能購電協議，由Big Island電廠供應。連同先前規劃的能源設施，整體新增資源將超過1GW太陽能及2,800MWh電池儲能，相關新設施預計2028年投入服務。
這些設備各自扮演不同角色。太陽能提供新增電力來源，儲能系統提高供電調度彈性，變電站與輸電線則負責將電力送往資料中心。對需要長時間穩定運作的AI資料中心而言，單純增加發電量已不足以滿足需求，還必須同步強化儲能及電網輸送能力。
值得注意的是，Google自行負擔新增供電成本，也有助於降低當地居民對電價上漲的疑慮。Entergy估計，第二階段合作自2028年起，未來20年可為其他用戶節省至少5億美元。不過，這項效益仍屬公司預估，相關擴建計畫及新增太陽能購電安排，也須取得阿肯色州公共服務委員會核准。

paras_en: October 21, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – As AI data center electricity demand soars, U.S. regions are worrying that large tech firms expanding compute capacity could push up residential electricity bills. Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent, has chosen to shoulder the cost of additional power itself. On the 19th, U.S. utility Entergy (ETR-US) announced that the two will expand their West Memphis, Arkansas data‑center partnership, planning roughly $600 million in power‑infrastructure investment. Google will cover the full cost of new supply facilities and, over a 20‑year contract, share existing grid fixed expenses to avoid passing expansion costs onto ordinary users.

This partnership reflects new challenges facing AI data centers. In the past, tech companies expanding data centers focused on servers, chips and compute equipment; now, as electricity use balloons, the adequacy of power supply, the grid’s ability to handle added load, and who bears construction costs are becoming key factors influencing data‑center investment.

Google announced in October 2025 that it plans to invest $4 billion by 2027 to build cloud and AI data centers in Arkansas. As the campus expands further, the original power capacity must be upgraded in tandem, prompting Google and Entergy to launch a second‑phase collaboration that widens the investment scope from power procurement to solar, battery storage, substations and transmission lines.

Under the latest plan, Entergy will build a 1,000 MWh battery storage system near Driver Solar and add another 400 MWh of storage near Hot Springs, totaling 1,400 MWh. It will also expand the Galet substation, construct two 230 kV transmission lines, and add a 440 MW solar power purchase agreement supplied by the Big Island plant. Combined with previously planned energy assets, the overall new resources will exceed 1 GW of solar and 2,800 MWh of battery storage, with the new facilities slated to enter service in 2028.

These assets each play distinct roles. Solar provides new generation capacity, storage systems boost dispatch flexibility, and substations and transmission lines deliver power to the data center. For AI data centers that require long‑running, stable operation, merely adding generation is insufficient; storage and grid transmission capabilities must be strengthened simultaneously.

Notably, Google’s decision to fund the additional power costs also helps allay local residents’ concerns about rising electricity rates. Entergy estimates that the second‑phase collaboration, starting in 2028, could save other users at least $500 million over the next 20 years. However, this benefit remains a company estimate, and the expansion plans and new solar purchase agreements still require approval from the Arkansas Public Service Commission.

paras: 美元周二(20日)走低，與油價及較長天期美國公債殖利率下跌走勢一致。交易員正評估美國與伊朗戰事緊張情勢升高的影響，以及資金持續大舉流入美國AI企業的趨勢能否延續。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.25%，報101.71。
油價在觸及五個月高點後回落。交易員一方面關注伊朗總統與巴基斯坦陸軍參謀長的會面，後者是美伊談判的重要斡旋者。另一方面，也評估葉門青年運動（ Houthi）持續攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯基礎設施，以及波斯灣海域傳出船隻遭襲的消息。
油價上漲加深了市場對通膨可能在更長時間內維持高檔的憂慮。上週，美國公布的數據顯示，9月消費者物價通膨加速，帶動美元走強。
然而，市場焦點很快又轉向AI相關疑慮。
野村證券G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning表示，「能源價格上漲有利美元，但如果利率因此升得太高，甚至導致AI交易行情崩盤，情況就會突然轉為不利因素。我們面臨一道臨界點，而目前市場正處於這個臨界點附近。」
大量資金流入美國AI股票，一直為美元提供支撐。部分與AI產業相關的成長及通膨預期推升利率，也進一步支撐美元。
不過，週二稍早，市場對AI的疑慮再度升溫。南韓AI服務公司Elice Group在首爾股市掛牌首日，股價暴跌32%。
歐元兌美元上漲0.22%，至1.1235美元。

法國政府週二表示，將增派軍警支援，並為週六預計舉行的新一輪抗議活動部署大規模維安措施。政府同時承認，在應對上週末的暴力事件時處置失當。
瑞典商業銀行（Handelsbanken）外匯策略師Tommy von Brömsen表示，「法國面臨的憂慮短期內不會消退。市場對法國的看空情緒還會持續一段時間，歐元也仍有進一步走弱的空間。」
英鎊兌美元上漲0.59%，至1.338美元。
英國最新公布的勞動市場數據顯示，就業市場仍具韌性，這也是近期一系列優於預期的英國經濟數據之一。
eToro全球市場策略師Lale Akoner表示，「風險在於，強韌的勞動市場可能讓英格蘭銀行(BoE)既有空間、也有理由再次升息。升息預期升高，可能有利英鎊。」
根據LSEG數據，市場幾乎已完全反映英格蘭銀行將在11月5日的下次會議升息1碼。
日本長天期公債(JGBs)標售吸引創紀錄的需求，帶動日元走強。
道富投資管理公司資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo表示，「20年期公債標售創下紀錄，強烈顯示先前觀望的資金終於開始回流。日本公債也逐漸成為相對安全的避風港，可用來因應歐洲政治與財政局勢的波動，尤其是法國的相關風險。」

paras_en: The dollar fell on Tuesday (the 20th), moving in line with declining oil prices and longer‑term U.S. Treasury yields. Traders are weighing the impact of heightened U.S.–Iran conflict risk and whether the massive inflow of capital into U.S. AI firms can continue.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.25% to 101.71.

Oil prices retreated after hitting a five‑month high. Traders are watching a meeting between Iran’s president and the Pakistani army chief, a key mediator in U.S.–Iran talks, while also assessing the Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and reports of a vessel being struck in the Persian Gulf.

Higher oil prices have deepened market worries that inflation could stay elevated for a longer period. Last week, U.S. data showed September consumer‑price inflation accelerating, which had previously boosted the dollar.
However, market focus quickly shifted back to AI‑related concerns.

Dominic Bunning, head of G10 FX strategy at Nomura Securities, said, “Rising energy prices are supportive of the dollar, but if rates climb too high and even trigger a collapse in AI trading activity, the situation could flip to a negative factor. We are at a critical juncture, and the market is currently hovering near that point.”
Large inflows into U.S. AI stocks have been underpinning the dollar. Some growth and inflation expectations tied to the AI sector have pushed rates higher, further supporting the greenback.
Nevertheless, early on Tuesday, doubts about AI resurfaced. South Korean AI services firm Elice Group saw its shares plunge 32% on the first day of trading on the Seoul exchange.
The euro rose 0.22% against the dollar to $1.1235.
Even though the euro gained on Tuesday, traders remain cautious about its outlook as France faces massive protests and a deteriorating fiscal situation.

The French government said on Tuesday it will deploy additional military police and implement extensive security measures ahead of a new round of protests expected on Saturday, while also acknowledging mishandling of last weekend’s violent incidents.

Tommy von Brömsen, FX strategist at Sweden’s Handelsbanken, said, “The concerns facing France will not dissipate in the short term. Bearish sentiment on France is likely to persist for a while, leaving room for the euro to weaken further.”
The pound rose 0.59% against the dollar to $1.338.
The latest UK labour market data show the employment market remains resilient, adding to a series of recent UK economic releases that have outperformed expectations.

Lale Akoner, global markets strategist at eToro, said, “The risk is that a robust labour market could give the Bank of England both the space and the incentive to raise rates again. Higher rate‑rise expectations could be bullish for the pound.”
LSEG data indicate the market has almost fully priced in a one‑basis‑point rate hike by the Bank of England at its next meeting on November 5.
Japan’s long‑term government bond (JGB) auction attracted record demand, strengthening the yen.

Masahiko Loo, senior fixed‑income strategist at State Street Global Advisors, said, “The record‑setting 20‑year bond auction shows that previously cautious capital is finally flowing back. Japanese bonds are increasingly seen as a relatively safe haven to hedge against volatility in European political and fiscal developments, especially the risks linked to France.”
The yen rose 0.21% against the dollar to ¥158.14.

In other currencies, residents of Alberta, Canada, voted in the province’s first separatist referendum, with a majority supporting staying in Canada. After the result was announced, the Canadian dollar rose 0.34% to C$1.406, its strongest level in nearly a month.

paras: 股匯雙殺再現，三大法人今(20)日合計賣超台股968.04億元，外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元終場收在32.617元，重貶1.72角，成交金額達32.77億美元；元太外匯市場成交金額為9.995億美元。兩大外匯市場今日成交金額合計高達 42.765 億美元，顯示在熱錢急退與避險結匯需求湧現下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
新台幣今日以32.48元開出，盤中最高32.48元，隨後受外資擴大匯出影響，一度衝破32.67元關卡，盤中下探至32.672元，最低重貶2.27角，全日維持弱勢重貶格局。
從國際盤與總體環境觀察，雖然美股科技族群昨日出現逢低買盤，帶動那斯達克與費城半導體指數反彈，但亞幣整體維持弱勢格局，直接加重了新台幣的走貶壓力。市場資金在區域資產間快速挪移，外資於台股及匯市同步進行提款操作，形成匯市盤中沉重的下行連動壓力。
在台股與籌碼面部分，根據臺灣證券交易所統計數據，台股今日受電子權值股走弱影響，終場下跌529.15點，收在46292.93點，成交金額為7586.84億元。三大法人今日合計賣超台股968.04億元，其中外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，自營商賣超355.79億元，僅投信逆勢買超183.15億元，顯示外資大舉提款並將資金轉匯出境，是引發今日股匯雙殺的核心因素。
觀察市場後續演變，匯銀人士與市場專家分析指出，新台幣短線能否止貶回穩，完全取決於美股財報週表現及外資提款動作是否放緩。目前新台幣匯率陷於32.6元拉鋸戰，若熱錢匯出趨勢短期內未能平息，匯市不排除進一步回測32.8元關卡。
paras_en: The double blow to stocks and the foreign exchange market reappeared today, with the three major institutional investors collectively selling NT$96.804 billion of Taiwan equities. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors accounted for a net sell of NT$79.54 billion. The Taipei FX market closed at NT$32.617 per US $, a depreciation of 0.172 NTD, with a turnover of US$3.277 billion; the Yuan‑Tai FX market saw a turnover of US$0.9995 billion. Combined, the two FX markets handled US$4.2765 billion, indicating unusually vigorous trading amid a rapid outflow of hot money and a surge in hedging demand.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$32.48 and peaked at NT$32.48 intraday. It then slipped as foreign investors accelerated outflows, briefly breaching the NT$32.67 barrier and falling to NT$32.672, a low that represented a 0.227 NTD weakening. The currency remained in a weak, depreciating stance throughout the session.

Looking at the international markets and the broader environment, U.S. tech stocks rallied yesterday, lifting the Nasdaq and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index. However, Asian currencies stayed weak overall, adding pressure to the TWD’s decline. Capital shifted quickly among regional assets, and foreign investors withdrew from both Taiwan equities and the FX market simultaneously, creating a heavy downward linkage in the currency market.

On the equity side, Taiwan Stock Exchange data show that the market was dragged down by weaker electronic‑sector leaders, closing down 529.15 points at 46,292.93 with a turnover of NT$758.684 billion. The three major institutional investors sold a total of NT$96.804 billion of stocks, of which foreign and mainland investors net‑sold NT$79.54 billion, proprietary traders sold NT$35.579 billion, while only mutual funds bought NT$18.315 billion against the trend. The large‑scale foreign outflow and capital repatriation were the core drivers of today’s stock‑FX double‑hit.

Looking ahead, FX analysts and market experts say the short‑term fate of the TWD hinges on U.S. earnings reports and whether foreign capital withdrawals ease. The TWD is currently locked in a tug‑of‑war around the NT$32.6 level; if hot‑money outflows persist, the market could test the NT$32.8 barrier further downwards.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 法國動亂與暴力抗議拖累歐元
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Strengthens as French Unrest and Violent Protests Drag Down Euro
paras: 美元周一(19日)走強，主要受到歐元下跌，以及美國債券市場再度出現拋售潮的推動。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報102。此前，美元指數出現近五週以來首次單週下跌，主要因市場對美國聯準會（Fed）短期內升息的預期略微降溫。
法國陷入動盪
美國及全球外匯市場的參與者，正密切關注法國局勢不斷升級的情況。
作為歐元區第二大經濟體，法國週末爆發大規模暴力抗議，民眾不滿生活成本飆升，以及公共服務經費不足。同時，法國本身也正面臨財政危機。
法國各城市有數千人與警方發生衝突，部分商店遭到洗劫，造成近年來最嚴重社會動亂之一。暴力事件進一步加大法國總統馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）政治壓力。在 2027 年任期結束前，他的施政已因日益高漲的社會不滿情緒而陷入愈發嚴重的停滯。
由於法國政府公債（OAT）表現落後，而透過信用違約交換（CDS）為法國主權債務投保的成本也升至多年高點，法國公債與德國聯邦公債（Bund）之間的利差進一步擴大，對歐元構成直接的基本面壓力。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.3%，至 1.1210 美元。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師 Thierry Wizman 表示，「法國的社會局勢可能帶來一種和平且具宣洩效果的改變，例如透過提高退休年齡來推動緊縮政策，前提是民主制度能夠維持穩定。然而，真正可能引發轉變的 2027 年大選，對大多數交易員而言仍太遙遠。他們更擔心的是未來幾週的局勢發展。」
他進一步指出，「只要電視畫面持續出現混亂景象，市場就傾向於賣出歐元，並推高法國主權債務利差。如果法國出現存款外流，將可能促使歐洲央行（ECB）介入，而這很可能進一步削弱歐元。」
法國 10 年期公債殖利率週一大幅上升，債券拋售壓力也蔓延至美國市場。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 4.5 個基點，來到 5.145%。對利率政策較為敏感的 2 年期公債殖利率則上升 4 個基點，來到 4.776%。
日元走弱 加幣走強
日元走弱，美元兌日元升至 158.53。
日本當局先前已與美國釋出聯合警告訊號，外匯交易部門對東京當局可能在目前價位進場干預匯市，仍保持高度警戒。
日本銀行（BoJ）總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在公開談話中表示，日本的基礎通膨正穩步接近央行設定的 2% 目標。
植田的發言進一步強化市場預期：央行仍將循序漸進地推動貨幣政策正常化。因此，利率市場持續關注日銀今年稍晚可能採取的貨幣政策調整。
另一方面，印尼盾終於停止連續四個交易日的跌勢。在這波下跌期間，印尼盾一度貶至 1 美元兌 18,063 印尼盾，創下近三個月來最低。
這波拋售潮起因是 MSCI 提議調降印尼股票市場評級，理由是印尼市場長期存在外資進入不易及公司治理方面的疑慮。
這項提議引發印尼雅加達綜合指數單日暴跌 11.6%，創下 1998 年亞洲金融風暴以來最大單日跌幅。
其他市場方面，加拿大幣兌美元走強，美元兌加拿大元跌至 1.4110。
加拿大消費者通膨加速，提升了市場對加拿大央行(BoC)可能採取較強硬貨幣政策的預期。
根據加拿大統計局公布數據，加拿大 9 月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率為 3.1%，低於經濟學家預估的 3.2%，但高於 8 月的 3.0%。
此外，這也是加拿大 CPI 連續三個月上升後，首次超出加拿大央行設定的 1% 至 3% 通膨目標區間。
本次 CPI 上升主要受到能源價格推動。能源價格年增 19%，其中汽油價格更大幅上漲 27.8%。
加拿大央行總裁 Tiff Macklem 已表示，通膨可能進一步上升。儘管他也指出，目前還沒有太多證據顯示，價格壓力已經擴散至其他商品與服務。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Monday (the 19th), mainly driven by a falling euro and a renewed wave of selling in the U.S. bond market.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 102. Earlier, the index had posted its first weekly decline in nearly five weeks, as expectations for near‑term Fed rate hikes cooled slightly.
France in Turmoil
Market participants in the U.S. and global FX markets are watching the escalating situation in France closely.

As the euro‑area’s second‑largest economy, France saw massive violent protests over the weekend, with citizens angry about soaring living costs and underfunded public services, while the country also faces a fiscal crisis.

Thousands clashed with police in cities across France, some shops were looted, creating one of the most severe social upheavals in recent years. The violence adds political pressure on President Emmanuel Macron, whose agenda is increasingly stalled by rising social discontent ahead of the end of his term in 2027.

Because French government bonds (OAT) have underperformed and the cost of insuring French sovereign debt via credit‑default swaps (CDS) has risen to multi‑year highs, the spread between French OATs and German Bunds has widened, putting direct fundamental pressure on the euro.
The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1210.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “France’s social situation could lead to a peaceful, venting‑type change, such as raising the retirement age to push a tightening agenda, provided the democratic system remains stable. However, the real catalyst – the 2027 election – is still too far away for most traders. They are more concerned about how the situation develops over the next few weeks.”

He added, “As long as TV screens keep showing chaos, markets tend to sell euros and push French sovereign spreads higher. If France sees capital outflows, the European Central Bank may step in, which could further weaken the euro.”
French 10‑year bond yields jumped sharply on Monday, and bond‑selling pressure spread to the U.S. market.
U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose 4.5 basis points to 5.145%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbed 4 basis points to 4.776%.
Yen Weakens, Canadian Dollar Strengthens
The yen weakened as the dollar rose to ¥158.53.
Japanese authorities have previously signaled a joint warning with the United States, and the FX trading desk remains on high alert for possible intervention by Tokyo officials at current levels.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said in a public remarks that Japan’s core inflation is steadily moving toward the central bank’s 2% target.
Ueda’s comments reinforced market expectations that the BOJ will continue a gradual normalization of monetary policy, keeping rate markets focused on potential policy adjustments later this year.
On the other hand, the Indonesian rupiah finally halted a four‑day losing streak. During the decline it had slipped to IDR 18,063 per dollar, a three‑month low.
The sell‑off was sparked by an MSCI proposal to downgrade Indonesia’s equity market rating, citing long‑standing difficulties for foreign investors and corporate‑governance concerns.
The proposal triggered an 11.6% single‑day plunge in the Jakarta Composite Index, the biggest daily drop since the 1998 Asian financial crisis.
In other markets, the Canadian dollar rose against the dollar, with USD/CAD slipping to 1.4110.
Canadian consumer inflation accelerated, raising expectations that the Bank of Canada may adopt a tighter policy stance.
Statistics Canada reported that September’s CPI rose 3.1% year‑over‑year, below the 3.2% forecast but above August’s 3.0%.
It also marked the first time in three months that Canada’s CPI moved above the BoC’s 1%‑3% target range.
The CPI increase was mainly driven by energy prices, which rose 19% year‑over‑year, with gasoline jumping 27.8%.
Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem said inflation could rise further, though he noted there is still limited evidence that price pressures have spread to other goods and services.
